newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Coast completes $10 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Coast completes $10 mln financing.

text.p: Atlantic Coast Airlines said Wednesday it has completed financing of a $10 million aircraft maintenance hangar to be constructed at Washington-Dulles International Airport.
The company said the 85,000 square foot facility is designed to centralize its operations at Washington-Dulles and provide about 300 new jobs in Virginia.
Atlantic Coast will lease the facility from the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority.
The company said it plans to relocate its overnight aircraft maintenance facility from Lynchburg, Virginia when it maves into the new Dulles-based facility in March 1998.
Funds for constructing the maintenance hangar will come from proceeds of a $9.4 variable rate bond issue underwritten by Wheat First Securities Inc.
The bonds, which qualify for tax-exempt status, were issued by the Industrial Development Authority of Loudoun County, Va.
